legend: Graph constructive problems are back! This time the graph you are asked to build should match the following properties.
The graph is connected if and only if there exists a path between every pair of vertices.
The diameter (aka "longest shortest path") of a connected undirected graph is the maximum number of edges in the shortest path between any pair of its vertices.
The degree of a vertex is the number of edges incident to it.
Given a sequence of n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ construct a connected undirected graph of n$$$n$$$ vertices such that:
the graph contains no self-loops and no multiple edges;
the degree di$$$d_i$$$ of the i$$$i$$$-th vertex doesn't exceed ai$$$a_i$$$ (i.e. di≤ai$$$d_i \le a_i$$$);
the diameter of the graph is maximum possible.
Output the resulting graph or report that no solution exists.
input: The first line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (3≤n≤500$$$3 \le n \le 500$$$) — the number of vertices in the graph.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤n−1$$$1 \le a_i \le n - 1$$$) — the upper limits to vertex degrees.
output: Print "NO" if no graph can be constructed under the given conditions.
Otherwise print "YES" and the diameter of the resulting graph in the first line.
The second line should contain a single integer m$$$m$$$ — the number of edges in the resulting graph.

The i$$$i$$$-th of the next m$$$m$$$ lines should contain two integers vi,ui$$$v_i, u_i$$$ (1≤vi,ui≤n$$$1 \le v_i, u_i \le n$$$, vi≠ui$$$v_i \neq u_i$$$) — the description of the i$$$i$$$-th edge. The graph should contain no multiple edges — for each pair (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ you output, you should output no more pairs (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ or (y,x)$$$(y, x)$$$.
note: Here are the graphs for the first two example cases. Both have diameter of 2$$$2$$$.

legend.ai: 图构造题又回来了！这一次，你需要构造的图应满足以下性质。
当且仅当任意一对顶点之间都存在一条路径时，该图是连通的。
连通无向图的直径（即“最长最短路径”）定义为：任意一对顶点之间的最短路径中，边数的最大值。
一个顶点的度是与它相关联的边的条数。
给定一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的整数序列 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$，构造一个包含 n$$$n$$$ 个顶点的连通无向图，使得：
该图不含自环且不含重边；
第 i$$$i$$$ 个顶点的度 di$$$d_i$$$ 不超过 ai$$$a_i$$$(即 di≤ai$$$d_i \le a_i$$$)。
输出所得的图，或者报告不存在解。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(3≤n≤500$$$3 \le n \le 500$$$)——图中顶点的数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$(1≤ai≤n−1$$$1 \le a_i \le n - 1$$$)——顶点度数的上限。

output.ai: 如果无法在给定条件下构造出图，则输出 "NO"。
否则，在第一行输出 "YES" 和所得图的直径。
第二行应包含一个整数 m$$$m$$$——所得图中的边数。

接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行中的第 i$$$i$$$ 行应包含两个整数 vi,ui$$$v_i, u_i$$$(1≤vi,ui≤n$$$1 \le v_i, u_i \le n$$$，vi≠ui$$$v_i \neq u_i$$$)——对第 i$$$i$$$ 条边的描述。图中不应包含重边——对于你输出的每一对 (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$，都不应再输出 (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$ 或 (y,x)$$$(y, x)$$$。

note.ai: 这里给出了前两个样例的图。两者的直径均为 2$$$2$$$。
